r2BridgeOnDemand.securityResidual: While the trust gate is closed the on-demand path is accepted with a known residual. A bridge global (trust, verifier, compare or facade) that is already defined before the first load keeps the bridge closed (the loader refuses to inject over a taken name). But a script already running in the shell realm that defines a locked, frozen global while that file is being injected is accepted, and so is the static-tag path. The residual applies to all four bridge globals, not only the facade. Before the gate is ever opened with a real key, the bridge must first move back to eager tags or into a Worker (R-4 key-ceremony guide).
